newsitem.title: UK: Dry cargo market business dampened by holidays.
newsitem.headline: Dry cargo market business dampened by holidays.

text.p: In a very thin dry cargo market the Baltic Freight Index eased 6 points to 1517, recording its first decline since Nov 28 when it stood at 1423.
Most shipbrokers in the West are departing on holiday for Christmas, the Baltic Exchange will be closed on December 25, 26 and 27, and they will be followed by Japanese holidays throughout next week.
GRAIN - Very little news emerged today. Tradigrain were linked with Magda P for 30,000 wheat Rouen/Agadir for end Dec at close to a weak $11.00.
In the east, Pacific Carriers were rumoured to have booked a 45,000 dwt vessel delivery South Korea early Jan for trip via Nopac to Indonesia at about $7,900 daily.

MINERALS - Hoogovens were said to have fixed Caper tonnage on private terms for coal from Maracaibo or La Cienaga to Rotterdam. British Steel paid a hefty $12,500 daily for Hedvig 133,357 dwt delivery Dunkirk early Jan for a trip via Brazil with ironore to U.K.
Panamax coal business was said to have been completed by Cobelfret with Orjen 72,150 dwt for 3.5/4 months timecharter basis delivery prompt Passero but a rate was not reported.
Umberto d'Amato 75,000 dwt was rumoured fixed delivery Naples early Jan for 2 laden legs Atlantic trading at over $12,000 daily, possibly for account of Deiulemar.
There was a 50,000 bauxite Kamsar/Pt Comfort fixture reported at a firm $9.00, rumoured by Alcoa.

In the Pacific British Steel took Co-op Venture 68,683 dwt for a coal cargo from Roberts Bank to UK for Jan 15/25 on private terms. Western Trade 65,083 dwt failed on subjects with Pan Ocean delivery Jakarta mid Jan for 3-5 months at $11,000/11,250 daily.
HANDIES - For other than modern craned bulkers the market on the Continent remained weak, as shown by Tradigrain's fixture of Magda P 34,194 dwt mentioned above.
Taxiharhis P 39,000 dwt open prompt Norway was fixed on private terms and Calliroe Patronicola 29,000 dwt was understood to be working closely basis Continent end Dec.
